operation.body:
### Goal

Implement feedback submission (FR-001): users can submit a title and description; valid input persists one feedback item and invalid input shows readable errors with preserved input.

### Acceptance criteria

- A `Feedback` (or equivalent) model stores title and description with server-side presence validation; blank title or description is rejected without creating a row.
- A submission form uses labelled, keyboard-accessible controls; user-entered text is escaped on render.
- After validation failure, the form redisplays entered values and readable error messages; the user can submit again successfully.
- Automated tests cover successful creation and rejection of blank required fields at an appropriate boundary (model and/or request).
- Pull request contains exact `Closes #<this-issue-number>` and stays within this goal scope.

### Constraints

- Ruby on Rails, SQLite, server-rendered HTML; MIT license; no authentication.
- Default category may be `other` at the schema level if needed for later FR-003, but categorization UI and filtering are out of scope here.
- Do not edit `docs/security-review.md` or implement goal #3 work.
- Report only checks that actually ran.

### Out of scope

- Browsing or listing feedback (FR-002), category assignment UI (FR-003), filters (FR-004), restart persistence demo beyond normal DB usage (FR-005), invalid-category API handling beyond this form (FR-006), full FR-007/FR-008 delivery, sample dataset, and demo recording.

### Relevant context

Rails runtime readiness merged on `main` (goal #4, PR #6). Project readiness gate passes in `.ai/docs/project-requirements.md`. Parent project #2 targets FR-001–FR-008 overall; this is the first product behaviour slice.
